context: Create unique pictorial meme card artwork with exact identities and matching cropped material references.

The second reference provides actual matching material swatches; use its palette, fine surface finish and physical edge quality. Matching materials: Black piano lacquer, white enamel and brushed silver. Continue the image and material smoothly across the entire interior from top edge to bottom edge. All regions are finished pictorial artwork, with zero titles, captions, empty plates or reserved writing fields. Any intrinsic source-logo lettering stays exactly as in the first reference; introduce no other writing. Render the whole thin flat print directly front-on with smooth rounded corners, even neutral lighting, controlled material depth and sharp refined detail.
